text: OFFICER SHOOTING (SLUG) BN (ID) 1-11-19 5 A.M. (TIME/DATE) NANCE PKG TRT =1:05 (Story/Pkg run time) OFFICER SHOOTING FOLO [CLIP #1010] {TRT :10} {Outcue: EVERYBODY'S OK SO FAR }NEW AUDIO RECORDINGS HAVE BEEN RELEASED.... AS INVESTIGATORS LOOK INTO WHAT LEAD TO A MAN BEING SHOT AND KILLED BY SPOKANE POLICE, EARLIER THIS WEEK. OFFICERS RESPONDED TO WEST MONTGOMERY AVENUE MONDAY NIGHT...  WHEN A WOMAN CALLED 9-1-1 SAYING HER NEIGHBOR WAS SHOOTING AT HER.(TOSS NANCE) KXLY'S ROBIN NANCE WITH MORE---------TAKE PKG------------------------------*ONE OFFICER REPORTED HEARING A GUNSHOT ON SCENE -- SHORTLY BEFORE POLICE USED DEADLY FORCE... BUT NO WEAPON WAS EVER FOUND. POLICE DID FIND A METAL BASEBALL BAT, AND THEY SAY IT'S LIKELY THAT DAVID NOVAK... THE MAN SHOT AND KILLED... WAS HITTING IT AGAINST A PICKUP TRUCK. THE MOMENTS LEADING UP TO THE FATAL SHOT PLAYED OUT OVER POLICE RADIO. [ACT 1011] [TRT = :08] {Outcue: HE FIRED A SHOT FOR SURE I SAW SMOKE OVER BY THE HOUSE }NEIGHBORS WHO CALLED POLICE MONDAY NIGHT SAID NOVAK WAS INTOXICATED... USED RACIAL SLURS... AND STATED SEVERAL TIMES THAT HE WAS A K-K-K MEMBER.THOSE NEIGHBORS ALSO TOLD POLICE THAT NOVAK THREATENED TO SHOOT AND KILL THEM.SPOKANE POLICE HAVE NOT RELEASED THE NAMES OF THE OFFICERS INVOLVED IN THIS SHOOTING.INDEPENDENT LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES ARE NOW INVESTIGATING, AND ONCE THEY'VE FINISHED, THE CASE WILL BE FORWARDED TO THE SPOKANE COUNTY PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE. {SOQ} EXCESSIVE FORCE SETTLEMENT (SLUG) 1-11-19 5 A.M. (TIME/DATE) READER TRT :30 A MAN WHO SAID PULLMAN POLICE OFFICERS USED EXCESSIVE FORCE WHILE HE WAS HAVING A MENTAL HEALTH EPISODE BACK IN 2016 WILL BE AWARDED A HALF A MILLION DOLLAR SETTLEMENT THIS COMES FROM A REPORT FROM OUR SISTER STATION KQQQ IN PULLMAN. AT THE JACK IN THE BOX IN PULLMAN FORMER WSU STUDENT KYLE NORTH WAS PUSHED TO THE GROUND BY OFFICERS, TAZED AND THEN GRABED BY HIS NECK CAUSING HIM TO LOSE CONSCIOUSNESS, BODY CAM FOOTAGE FROM THE INCIDENT HAS BEEN VIEWED ON YOUTUBE THOUSANDS OF TIMES. PULLMAN POLICE OFFICERS CLAIM NORTH WAS RESISTING ARREST AND THAT HE WAS WARNED TO COMPLY WITH COMMANDS A 500 THOUSAND DOLLAR SETTLEMENT WAS REACHED LAST MONTH.
